subject: general
question: A family includes six members A, B, C, X, Y and Z. There are two married couples. B is an engineer and the father of Y. Z is the grandfather of C and is a scientist. X is the grandmother of Y and is a painter. Y and C are sisters and are cricketers. A is the mother of C and an actor. There is one engineer, one scientist, one actor, one painter and two cricketers in the group. Which of the following options is a group of male members only?
